rows.definition: The verbosity axis of the background-process completion watcher: decides WHICH terminal tool-process transitions wake a new agent turn (off/error/result/all) and HOW MUCH of the folded toolproc verdict rides into that turn.
rows.distinction: loop_observe.go reports in-turn progress to an observer without starting a turn; loop_park.go suspends a turn; loop_constraint.go gates turn admission. This seam alone decides whether a COMPLETED BACKGROUND PROCESS starts a NEW turn, and at what detail.
